note: Minecraft Java version facts. Sources: docs/_sections/formats_interop 2.2.2, 7.7, 9.1, 31.2, 31.3, 31.4, 32, 33.4. Pack formats come from the game code or the Minecraft Wiki table named in each "source"; a version without an entry has no confirmed number and stays unknown. A fact the specs mark UNVERIFIED, or that this file infers from them, is listed under "unverified" of its entry and explained in "note".

tiers.note: Reference layout (interop 31.2, range from interop 32). Rotation rule from interop 2.2.2: one axis, 0, 22.5, 45, 315 or 337.5. Display slots from interop 7.7. Texture folders blocks/ and items/.

Interop 31.2 lists only the texture folders block/ and item/ as a change, so the rotation rule is inherited from java-1.12. The display slot list is assumed unchanged between the lists of interop 7.7 and 31.2 (26.3); the specs do not state it for this range.

Item definitions assets/<ns>/items/<id>.json replace overrides (interop 31.2, 31.3). Rotation inherited. The exact item-definition property names are UNVERIFIED (interop 33.4) but the validator does not read them.
Single-axis rotation with any angle in [-45, 45] according to Blockbench 5.2.2; not verified against the client (interop 31.2, 33.4 item 1).
Multi-axis element rotation (interop 31.2). The specs give no angle range for it, so none is checked.
Display contexts confirmed in the 26.3 game code (interop 31.2). Rotation inherited from java-1.21.11. shade_direction_override is UNVERIFIED in vanilla (interop 31.2) and not used by the validator.
